blindWork: 3.00x10^8 m/s divided by 201.168 m/furlong gives 1.4913x10^6 furlongs per second. A fortnight is 14 x 24 x 3600 = 1,209,600 s. So 1.4913x10^6 x 1.2096x10^6 = 1.80x10^12 furlongs/fortnight.
stem: The speed of light is $3.00 \times 10^{8}\text{~m/s}$. Express this speed in furlongs per fortnight. ($1\text{~furlong} = 201.168\text{~m}$; $1\text{~fortnight} = 14\text{~days}$).
